The vcpkg-built x64-windows dependencies were produced from:
https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg.git
Commit: 7e43e0768a5af180a9cf75d87d692dce1b9da34f

The exact native dependency graph is locked by vcpkg.json. Direct versions:
- asio 1.36.0 (pinned overlay port)
- fmt 12.2.0#1
- gtest 1.18.0 (host tool)
- jsoncpp 1.9.6
- lz4 1.10.0
- OpenSSL 3.6.5 (pinned overlay port, official release archive)
- tap-windows6 9.21.2-0e30f5c#2
- xxhash 0.8.3

Flutter dependencies are locked separately by the application pubspec.yaml
and pubspec.lock, using the bundled Flutter 3.44.9 and Dart 3.12.2.
The supported Flutter SDK range is >=3.44.7 <3.45.0.

ARM64 dependencies were rebuilt for FuzeVPN 1.0.1 from the same pinned vcpkg
source commit and overlays listed above. Direct runtime port versions match
the locked graph. Build mode: isolated classic install, arm64-windows, dynamic
CRT and libraries. Compiler: MSVC 14.50.35717 Hostx64/arm64; OpenSSL assembly
compiler: official LLVM 21.1.8. No AMD64 dependency files were replaced.
Build evidence: build/release-1.0.1/native-dependencies/vcpkg-arm64-build.log.
